title: Apple Discusses Multiple Payment Licensing Options, Plans to Invest Hundreds of Millions of Dollars to Introduce News Sources and Upgrade Siri AI
excerpt: According to the Wall Street Journal, Apple is in talks with multiple publishers for long-term content licensing agreements, aiming to use up-to-date news
content_html:
According to the Wall Street Journal, Apple is in talks with multiple publishers for long-term content licensing agreements, aiming to use up-to-date news and information from authoritative media to provide real-time information support for its upcoming Siri AI, which will be launched later this year. This move marks Apple's effort to accelerate the enhancement of its voice assistant AI's intelligence while trying to establish a new AI content ecosystem and business cooperation system.

Unlike the industry's common "fixed licensing fee" buyout model, Apple has proposed a dynamic compensation plan based on the actual usage of the content. According to reports, Apple has planned a dedicated budget of hundreds of millions of dollars for this. This on-demand payment mechanism aligns closely with the commercial revenue-sharing logic of the Apple News+ platform, significantly reducing the "hallucination" risk caused by large models directly generating or summarizing content, while ensuring users receive accurate and authentic real-time information.

In recent years, the relationship between tech giants and copyright holders has been reshaped, and AI companies have generally faced copyright lawsuits and data compliance challenges. Apple's initiative to introduce compliant data through a variable compensation model not only reflects its strategic intent to rapidly address its shortcomings in the generative AI competition, but also explores a sustainable and compliant model for content copyright distribution in the era of large models.

content_html_zh:
据《华尔街日报》报道，苹果正在与多家出版商就长期内容授权协议进行谈判，旨在利用权威媒体的最新新闻和信息，为其即将于今年晚些时候推出的 Siri AI 提供实时信息支持。 此举标志着苹果在加速提升语音助手AI智能化程度的同时，试图建立全新的AI内容生态和商业合作体系。

与业界常见的“固定授权费”买断模式不同，苹果提出了根据内容实际使用情况的动态补偿计划。 据报道，苹果为此计划了数亿美元的专门预算。 这种按需付费机制与Apple News+平台的商业收益分享逻辑紧密契合，显着降低了大模型直接生成或汇总内容带来的“幻觉”风险，同时保证用户收到准确、真实的实时信息。

近年来，科技巨头与版权持有者之间的关系被重塑，人工智能企业普遍面临版权诉讼和数据合规挑战。 苹果主动通过可变补偿模型引入合规数据，不仅体现了其在生成式AI竞争中快速弥补短板的战略意图，也探索了大模型时代内容版权分发的可持续合规模式。
